<!-- Thank you for your contribution! Please follow these guidelines to enhance your pull request. If anything is unclear, submit your PR and reach out to maintainers for assistance. Join our Slack community at https://slack.sglang.io to discuss further. -->

## Motivation

`torch_npu.npu_top_k_top_p` requires same `dtype` for `logits` and `top_p`. Currently for models like CosyVoice3 from SGLang-Omni it produced error as `logits` come in `blfloat16` while `top_p` in `float32`.

## Modifications

`top_p` casted to `logits.dtype`. Make calculation in original dtype

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Enabling `--tts_engine.engine.sampling-backend ascend` gives `5%` speed up for CosyVoice3

<details>
    <summary>results</summary>

sampling backend pytorch (before)
```
sgl-omni serve --model-path /home/weights/FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512/
```
```
============================================================
                   Speed Benchmark Result                   
============================================================

  Concurrency:                   10
  Completed requests:            1088
  Failed requests:               0
------------------------------------------------------------
  Latency mean (s):              5.269
  Latency median (s):            4.909
  Latency p95 (s):               7.018
  Latency p99 (s):               8.83
  RTF mean:                      1.1238
  RTF median:                    1.055
  RTF p95:                       1.6849
  RTF p99:                       2.345
  Audio duration mean (s):       5.141
  Audio throughput (s/s):        9.746
  Output throughput (tok/s):     243.7
  Output tokens/request-s:       48.2
  Output tokens (mean):          129
  Output tokens (total):         139848
  Prompt tokens (mean):          154
  Prompt tokens (total):         167806
  Throughput (req/s):            1.896
============================================================
``` 

sampling backend ascend (after)
```
sgl-omni serve --model-path /home/weights/FunAudioLLM/Fun-CosyVoice3-0.5B-2512/ --tts_engine.engine.sampling_backend ascend
```
```
============================================================
                   Speed Benchmark Result                   
============================================================

------------------------------------------------------------
```

</details>

files.patch:
@@ -874,6 +874,7 @@ def top_k_top_p_min_p_sampling_from_logits_ascend(
     """
     # torch_npu.npu_top_k_top_p requires top_k value range in [1, 1024]
     if hasattr(torch_npu, "npu_top_k_top_p") and npu_top_k_top_p_eligible:
+        top_ps = top_ps.to(logits.dtype)
         logits_top_k_top_p = torch_npu.npu_top_k_top_p(logits, top_ps, top_ks)
         probs_top_k_top_p = logits_top_k_top_p.softmax(dim=-1)
